# π0.5 混合动作头防泄漏注意力

## 1. 问题

π0.5 混合动作头防泄漏注意力：实现下列接口并通过数值、边界和实验检查。

实现论文附录E/Figure18的训练注意力连接；prefix、离散FAST标签和连续动作expert的内容由调用者给定，省略模型预训练。

## 2. 核心公式

$$
M_{qk}=\begin{cases}k<P&q<P\\k<P\ \lor\ (P\le k\le q)&P\le q<P+F\\k<P\ \lor\ k\ge P+F&q\ge P+F\end{cases},\quad M\leftarrow M\land v_q\land v_k.
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

- `hybrid_attention_mask(valid: Tensor, prefix_length: int, fast_length: int) -> Tensor`

prefix仅看prefix；FAST看prefix与当前之前FAST；expert看prefix与所有expert。FAST包含干净动作标签，若允许expert读取，会在流匹配训练中泄漏答案。query与key两侧都需屏蔽padding。

## 4. 本题约定

valid为(B,L)布尔，prefix_length>=1，fast_length>=0且至少保留一个expert token。输出(B,L,L)布尔，行是query，列是key。FAST为已右移的teacher-forcing输入，可见自身；expert双向但不可见FAST。

校验辅助函数已提供。浮点输入为有限 CPU float32/float64，不修改输入；非法形状、类型、范围或掩码必须抛出 `ValueError`。

## 5. 交互图与确定性实验

`experiment.py` 在固定输入上调用提交的全部接口，记录学习或采样曲线与末端指标。实验逻辑和阈值见 T3，输出同样用于可视化。

可视化由 `viz/gen.py` 生成；T3 将你的函数传入同一实验并记录真实指标。这是小规模确定性教学实验，不是机器人基准成绩。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 来源与延伸

- [π₀.₅: a Vision-Language-Action Model with Open-World Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.16054) — Appendix E, Figure 18: attention mask for discrete and continuous action training
- [Verified source](https://arxiv.org/html/2504.16054v1)

核验日期：2026-10-28。扩展到完整论文系统还需要本题范围中明确省略的模型、数据和环境。

## 可重复实验记录

en.readme:
# π0.5 Leakage-Free Hybrid Action Attention

## 1. Exercise goal

π0.5 Leakage-Free Hybrid Action Attention: implement the interfaces below and verify numerical, boundary and experimental behavior.

Implement Appendix E / Figure 18 training attention connectivity. Prefix, discrete FAST labels and continuous action-expert contents are supplied; omit model pretraining.

## 2. Core equations

$$
M_{qk}=\begin{cases}k<P&q<P\\k<P\ \lor\ (P\le k\le q)&P\le q<P+F\\k<P\ \lor\ k\ge P+F&q\ge P+F\end{cases},\quad M\leftarrow M\land v_q\land v_k.
$$

## 3. From equations to code

- `hybrid_attention_mask(valid: Tensor, prefix_length: int, fast_length: int) -> Tensor`

Prefix queries see prefix only. FAST queries see prefix and causal FAST tokens. Expert queries see prefix and all expert tokens. FAST carries clean action labels, so expert-to-FAST access leaks the flow-matching target. Mask padding on both query and key axes.

## 4. Contract and boundaries

Valid is bool (B,L), prefix_length>=1, fast_length>=0 and at least one expert token remains. Return bool (B,L,L), rows=query, columns=key. FAST inputs are shifted teacher-forcing tokens and may attend themselves; expert attention is bidirectional but cannot see FAST.

Validation helpers are provided. All floating inputs are finite CPU float32/float64; do not mutate inputs. Invalid shape, dtype, range or mask arguments raise `ValueError`.

## 5. Deterministic experiment and visualization

`experiment.py` calls every submitted interface on fixed inputs and records a learning or sampling curve and terminal metrics. T3 states the behavioral thresholds; the visualization uses the same outputs.

The visualization is generated by `viz/gen.py`; T3 runs the same experiment with your functions and records its actual metrics. These are small deterministic teaching results, not a robot benchmark.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Sources and extensions

- [π₀.₅: a Vision-Language-Action Model with Open-World Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.16054) — Appendix E, Figure 18: attention mask for discrete and continuous action training
- [Verified source](https://arxiv.org/html/2504.16054v1)

Verified 2026-10-28. Extending this operator to the full paper requires the omitted model, data and environment described in the scope above.

## Mistakes caught by the tests

- Action-expert queries can read clean FAST action labels.
- The continuous action expert incorrectly uses causal rather than bidirectional attention.

## Experimental scope

Implement Appendix E / Figure 18 training attention connectivity. Prefix, discrete FAST labels and continuous action-expert contents are supplied; omit model pretraining.

## Reproducible protocol

Eight tokens split into three prefix, two FAST and three expert tokens; uniform legal attention and FAST perturbations 0/1/10/100/1000. Expert response must be zero, while prefix response exceeds .5. This is a forward information-flow experiment without a trainer.

The judge fixes seed 42. All calculations use CPU float64, explicit inputs and plain gradient updates where applicable; no datasets or model weights are downloaded. Native PyTorch and actual Pyodide/NumPy-WASM run the same T0–T3 suite. Thresholds refer to this teaching adaptation.
